peer_exposure.attribution_and_scope: The estimator is peer-originated; the row-prefix projection and sampler consequence are independently derived here. Other peer proofs were screened for interface compatibility, not fully reverified.

claims.claim: For rational-complex F and 0<=k<=n/2, peer c03_l10's randomized estimator has relative sample complexity O(9^k eps^-2 log(1/delta)); independently reconstructed from paired-volume expectation, formal square-root Pfaffian identity, and scalar Boolean-cube hypercontractivity.
Forced/excluded row-set mass is det(V_A*V_A) times a residual paired-volume sum after exact orthogonal projection, preserving relative estimation and exact-zero samples.

On the positive-sector promise, estimated row-prefix ratios plus exact conditional volume sampling of columns yield a canonical hard-BCS joint sampler within TV epsilon at polynomial bit cost for k=O(log n); end-to-end implementation is absent.
Exhaustive exact sign/prefix/volume checks on small n=4 cases pass; these are finite diagnostics, not proof certification.
No general polynomial-time approximation or approximation-hardness result for k=Theta(n) was established.
